frozen_interface_zone.tailward_rule: The read-only V0.42 directional reference establishes the attack end at lower Z. All allowed-shell vertices with world Z >= registration world Z are tailward/interface-zone vertices and are frozen.

geometry_edit.description: Forward/lower attack-end outer-shell taper with one asymmetric shoulder landmark and a short straight tip; no curve, bevel, material, scale or interface edit.

primary_secondary_tertiary_read.secondary: Forward taper and asymmetric upper shoulder transition
primary_secondary_tertiary_read.tertiary: Existing seams and functional recesses preserved; no new decorative clutter

structural_preservation.signal_validation_policy: Rails/carriers compared in P1/P2/P3. The recessed core endpoint/carrier is compared in active P3; its P1/P2 evaluated state is driver-controlled and not used as a geometry-edit verdict.

relative_scale_audit.method: Same V0.89 method: Blade = world-space union of ZB-prefixed mesh objects. Actor = world-Z union of render-enabled actor meshes, excluding all ZB objects and hidden legacy Blade/sword proxies.

deliverables.visual_inspection_scope: Evidence legibility, full-blade framing, locked-camera comparison, and solid-black silhouette integrity only; visual gates 1-3 remain operator-only.
